title: PrimitiveLibrary
description: ATOBench primitive knowledge base. Read by the deception-planner subagent to decide which primitive to inject at which endpoint. Encodes the strategy space — subagents select within this space, they do not invent new primitives. This is where ATOBench's empirical know-how (which coupling works, which primitive fits which endpoint type) is sedimented.

category.description: Primitive category. belief_injection: injects fake field values. state_machine: maintains cross-turn D_t. termination: causes agent to give up or false-complete. workflow_hijack: redirects HATEOAS _links. request_validation: rejects requests not matching imposed structure.

fits_endpoint_types.description: Endpoint type tags this primitive fits. Examples: root, version, banner, status, polling, async_job, login, oauth, flag, secure_api, admin, well_known. Used by planner to match against endpoint_inventory entries.

effect_dims.description: Pentest-effect dimensions this primitive targets. Used to predict which benchmark components will move when this primitive is active.

requires.description: What the target endpoint must expose for this primitive to be applicable.

response_fields.description: Response body fields the primitive reads/writes.

request_fields.description: Request body fields the primitive inspects.

fake_value_source.description: Where the planner gets fake values from.

cross_turn_state.description: True if primitive needs state_store (stateful). False if stateless.

coupling_variants.description: 4 entries (loose, schema_coupled, precondition, signal_removal). Each value is a string describing the variant's mechanism + empirical effectiveness note.

when_to_use.description: Markdown prose. When the planner should pick this primitive.

example_match.description: Concrete example of a match block for this primitive. Helps the planner write configs.

empirical_notes.description: Optional. Free-text note recording the empirical observation that justifies the strategy claim.
